jobs.title: Safety & Training Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Safety \& Training Coordinator**
==================================


**Position Summary**
--------------------


The Safety \& Training Coordinator supports the company’s safety and compliance programs through administrative coordination, data management, training delivery, and documentation control. This role plays a key part in maintaining training records, ensuring regulatory compliance, supporting incident investigations, and conducting new hire orientation and safety presentations.  

  

The ideal candidate is highly organized, detail\-oriented, comfortable with data entry systems, and confident presenting in front of large groups.
**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------


### **Training \& Orientation**


* Conduct new hire safety orientation and onboarding sessions.
* Present safety training programs to employees in classroom and group settings.
* Prepare training materials and assist with class setup and coordination.
* Schedule and track required online training programs.
* Maintain accurate training records and certifications.
* Ensure shop and mobile equipment training documentation is completed and uploaded properly.
* Assist in development and revision of safety procedures and site\-specific safety plans.

### **Data Entry \& Documentation Management**


* Scan, upload, and maintain training records in company systems (e.g., Quickbase, ISN, Avetta).
* Track and schedule client\-required online training.
* Upload Certificates of Insurance (COIs), policies, and client\-requested documentation.
* Track and calibrate air monitors and enter data into designated systems.
* Track Job Safety Analysis (JSA) completions and equipment inspections daily.
* Maintain electronic and physical safety files.
* Print and assemble foreman binders and training packets as needed.

### **Reporting \& Compliance Support**


* Conduct and document monthly fire extinguisher inspections.
* Assist with incident investigations, including documentation and report preparation.
* Ensure hazardous waste is properly labeled and coordinate disposal.
* Support safety reporting and documentation efforts.
* Assist with compliance tracking across multiple buildings or job sites.

### **Inventory \& Equipment Support**


* Monitor, stock, and issue Personal Protective Equipment (PPE).
* Ensure documentation for equipment training (40\+ pieces of equipment) is properly completed and recorded.
* Assist with mobile and shop equipment training documentation.

**Minimum Requirements**
------------------------


* High school diploma or equivalent required.
* 1–3 years of experience in an administrative, safety, training, or compliance\-related role preferred.
* OSHA Construction 30 Hour
* Basic computer skills required.
* Strong data entry and document management skills.
* Experience using databases or tracking systems (Quickbase, ISN, Avetta, or similar platforms preferred).
* Experience training and presenting in front of large groups.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Highly organized with strong attention to detail.
* Ability to manage multiple tasks and deadlines.
* Ability to maintain confidentiality of sensitive information.

**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------


* Experience in construction, industrial, or safety\-related environments.
* OSHA 500 Outreach Instructor
* Knowledge of OSHA documentation or compliance processes.
* Familiarity with safety training coordination.
* Experience assisting with incident investigations.


**Work Environment**
--------------------


Combination of office and shop/field environment.  

May require standing for extended periods during training sessions.  

Frequent interaction with employees at all levels of the organization.

jobs.description:
### **About Us**


Scorpion is the leading provider of technology and services helping local businesses thrive. We do this by helping customers understand local market dynamics, make the most of their marketing, and deliver experiences their customers will love. We offer tools to know what's going on with marketing, competitors, and customers. We put SEO, Reviews, Advertising, Email Marketing, Chat and Messaging, Social Media, Website, Lead Management, Appointment Scheduling, and more to work for local businesses. We're a technology\-led service with a human touch.### **About the Role**



The Senior Training Specialist owns the design, delivery, and continuous improvement of enablement programs for Customer Success, with a primary focus on onboarding and ongoing skills development for Marketing Assistants and Account Managers. This role independently develops and facilitates training across the Scorpion technology suite (Platform, CSX, CMS, My Site, Enterprise Portal), client communication and service standards, account management practices, and core digital marketing concepts.



Serving as a subject\-matter resource and strategic partner to Customer Success leaders and cross\-functional teams, the Senior Training Specialist identifies learning needs, translates business and performance gaps into effective learning solutions, and uses data and feedback to continuously improve programs. This role helps ensure client\-facing teams build the knowledge, skills, and confidence needed to ramp quickly and perform consistently.


**Internal candidates will receive priority consideration for this role. However, external applications are welcomed and will be reviewed if the position is not filled internally.**

North Los Angeles County Regional Center “NLACRC” is a private, non\-profit agency that is contracted with the State of California, Department of Developmental Services, to provide services to individuals with intellectual and developmental disabilities. We serve individuals across the lifespan from infants and toddlers, school age children, transition\-age youth, to adults and aging adults.

**Supervision**


Receives general supervision from the Training and Development Supervisor.

**The Position and Job Summary**


The Training Specialist II maintains training transcripts for staff in accordance with strategic initiatives set by the Training and Development Supervisor. They actively participate as a trainer in new hire training and other assigned trainings. They maintain all facets of the Learning Management System including, but not limited to user experience, automation, and programming of course enrollments, branding, and record management. Additionally, they serve as an instructional designer, provide recommendations, and prepare analysis for strategic reports to the Training and Development Supervisor.

**Employment Standards**


To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily.

* Available as a resource for the Training Specialist I as it relates to coordination of NLACRC trainings with trainers and staff. Provides additional support as needed.
* Tracks NLACRC new staff progress through New Staff Orientation (NSO) learning paths and informs staff, supervisors and the Training and Development Supervisor as needed. Analyzes post\-survey data to provide recommendations for upgrades to NSO courses, programs, and systems.
* Participates as a trainer for NSO training protocols and other training initiatives as assigned by the Training and Development Supervisor.
* Maintains and updates the user interface for the Learning Management System (LMS) front\-end to improve staff experience. Collaborates with the LMS developer to resolve technical issues related to LMS efficiencies.
* Lead administrator of the LMS, training library, and various training platforms as assigned by the Training and Development Supervisor.
* Monitors and updates back\-end functions of various LMS systems, standard operating procedures of the Training Unit, and other training processes as assigned by the Training and Development Supervisor.
* Maintains and updates the training library to ensure accurate information, current materials, and representation/communication of all training initiatives.
* Acts as lead training specialist as it relates to the set up/breakdown of in\-person training classes, and coordinates with other departments to support as necessary and assigned by the Training and Development Supervisor.
* Provides recommendations and conference room setup options to the Training and Development Supervisor to optimize learner and facilitator/trainer experience for in\-person trainings.
* Participates as an instructional designer for subject matter experts (SMEs) throughout the agency utilizing all aspects of the ADDIE model (Analysis, Design, Development, Implementation, Evaluation). Designs and develops eLearning and in\-person training as assigned by the Training and Development Supervisor.

* Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite (Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, SharePoint).
* Proficient working with eLearning software. Articulate 360, preferred.

Valid California Driver’s License and reliable transportation, or acceptable substitute, required.

* Participate in the Public Service Loan Forgiveness program

* Holidays – NLACRC offers 12 paid holidays throughout the year
* Most positions are offered a hybrid – remote option


Please note that benefit costs are pro\-rated for part\-time employees.

**Professional Development Opportunities \& Growth**


NLACRC values the professional development of staff! Many staff gain experience and enter into Supervisor, Manager or Director positions.
